source: PALS first-party authored, generic-OpenMath and Lean-verified candidate set

validation_contract.generic_openmath: Every card is validated by statement-semantics validation plus retrieval C14N validation while the manifest is generated.
validation_contract.lean: Run with --verify-lean to compile the full witness batch in pals-agent/lean-workspace.
validation_contract.local_db: Run with --verify-db --expected-db-count 253 to read-check local Draft ID and canonical-OpenMath collisions; no database write is performed.

scope_note: Bare proposition variables are not representable in the generic profile, so logic cards use concrete equality, order, membership, and subset atoms. Set variables remain untyped generic terms; cards avoid mixing carriers and make no typed-set claim beyond the ordinary single-carrier Lean witness.

induction_boundary.excluded: The general mathematical-induction schema: from P(0) and forall n, P(n) implies P(n+1), infer forall n, P(n).
induction_boundary.why_current_profile_cannot_represent_it: The generic profile has neither a Prop sort nor a binder for a predicate P : Nat -> Prop, and it has no induction or natural-recursion operator. Encoding P as a bare OMV would fail proposition validation.

induction_boundary.included: A concrete theorem whose Lean witness uses induction, such as n + 1 <= 2^n.
induction_boundary.why_safe: Its statement is an ordinary quantified natural-number proposition using current quant1, setname1:N, arith1, relation1, and logic1 symbols; induction is retained as proof strategy rather than inserted into the theorem proposition.

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, if x = y then y = x.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="x"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Use symmetry of equality as a direct proof.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y : ℝ) : x = y → y = x := by intro h; exact h.symm

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x, y, and z, if x = y and y = z then x = z.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="z"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="z"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="z"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="z"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Chain the two equality hypotheses by transitivity.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y z : ℝ) : x = y ∧ y = z → x = z := by rintro ⟨hxy, hyz⟩; exact hxy.trans hyz

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x, y, and z, if x = y then x + z = y + z.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="z"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="z"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="z"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="z"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Substitute equals for equals inside addition.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y z : ℝ) : x = y → x + z = y + z := by intro h; rw [h]

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, if x < y then it is not the case that y ≤ x.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="lt"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="not"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="leq"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="x"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Assume the opposite weak inequality and contradict strict order.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y : ℝ) : x < y → ¬ y ≤ x := by intro hlt hle; exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hle

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, if x < y then x is not equal to y.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="lt"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="neq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Assume equality and rewrite the strict inequality into an irreflexive one.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y : ℝ) : x < y → x ≠ y := by intro hlt heq; subst y; exact (lt_irrefl x) hlt

cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, it is not the case that x < x.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="not"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="lt"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="x"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Assume x < x and use irreflexivity of strict order.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x : ℝ) : ¬ x < x := lt_irrefl x

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, either x = y or x is not equal to y.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="or"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="neq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Apply decidability of equality to this concrete equality proposition.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y : ℝ) : x = y ∨ x ≠ y := eq_or_ne x y

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, not (x ≠ y) if and only if x = y.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="equivalent"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="not"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="neq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Prove each direction using equality reflexivity and a contradiction argument.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness:
example (x y : ℝ) : (¬ x ≠ y) ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact by_contra fun hxy => h hxy
  · intro h hxy
    exact hxy h

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, it is not the case that x < y and y ≤ x.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="not"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="lt"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="leq"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="x"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Assume both order statements and derive the contradiction x < x.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y : ℝ) : ¬ (x < y ∧ y ≤ x) := by rintro ⟨hlt, hle⟩; exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) hle

cards.canonical_statement: For all real x, y, and z, if x + z ≠ y + z then x ≠ y.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="z"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="y"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="z"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="neq"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="z"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMV name="y"/><OMV name="z"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="neq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="y"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Use the contrapositive: equal inputs yield equal sums after adding z.
sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the variables together with the stated atomic hypotheses.
translate: Read the hypotheses as the corresponding logical assertions.
derive: Apply the indicated logical rule or its order/equality instance.
conclude: State the required proposition with its original quantifiers.
cards.lean_witness: example (x y z : ℝ) : x + z ≠ y + z → x ≠ y := by intro hsum hxy; apply hsum; rw [hxy]

cards.canonical_statement: For every element x and sets A, B, x belongs to A ∪ B if and only if x belongs to A or x belongs to B.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="equivalent"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="union"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="or"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Unfold union membership into a disjunction.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary element and the displayed sets.
unfold: Translate the set operation into its membership condition.
logic: Apply the required conjunction, disjunction, or negation rule.
conclude: Reassemble the target membership proposition.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (x : α) (A B : Set α) : x ∈ A ∪ B ↔ x ∈ A ∨ x ∈ B := by simp

cards.canonical_statement: For every element x and sets A, B, x belongs to A ∩ B if and only if x belongs to A and x belongs to B.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="equivalent"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="intersect"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Unfold intersection membership into a conjunction.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary element and the displayed sets.
unfold: Translate the set operation into its membership condition.
logic: Apply the required conjunction, disjunction, or negation rule.
conclude: Reassemble the target membership proposition.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (x : α) (A B : Set α) : x ∈ A ∩ B ↔ x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B := by simp

cards.canonical_statement: For every element x and sets A, B, x belongs to A \ B if and only if x belongs to A and x does not belong to B.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="equivalent"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="setdiff"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="not"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Unfold set difference membership into membership and nonmembership.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary element and the displayed sets.
unfold: Translate the set operation into its membership condition.
logic: Apply the required conjunction, disjunction, or negation rule.
conclude: Reassemble the target membership proposition.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (x : α) (A B : Set α) : x ∈ A \ B ↔ x ∈ A ∧ x ∉ B := by simp

cards.canonical_statement: For every element x, x does not belong to the empty set.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="notin"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="set1" name="emptyset"/></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Assume membership in the empty set and eliminate the impossible hypothesis.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary element and the displayed sets.
unfold: Translate the set operation into its membership condition.
logic: Apply the required conjunction, disjunction, or negation rule.
conclude: Reassemble the target membership proposition.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (x : α) : x ∉ (∅ : Set α) := by simp

cards.canonical_statement: For every element x and sets A, B, if A is a subset of B and x belongs to A, then x belongs to B.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="A"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Apply the subset hypothesis to the displayed membership proof.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary candidate element of the source set.
unpack: Use the given subset or membership hypotheses.
derive: Apply the relevant inclusion rule to the element.
conclude: Since the element was arbitrary, establish the target subset or equality.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (x : α) (A B : Set α) : A ⊆ B → x ∈ A → x ∈ B := by intro h hx; exact h hx

cards.canonical_statement: For all sets A, B, C, if A ⊆ B and B ⊆ C then A ⊆ C.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/><OMV name="C"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="B"/><OMV name="C"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="C"/></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Apply the two inclusion maps successively to an arbitrary element.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary candidate element of the source set.
unpack: Use the given subset or membership hypotheses.
derive: Apply the relevant inclusion rule to the element.
conclude: Since the element was arbitrary, establish the target subset or equality.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (A B C : Set α) : A ⊆ B → B ⊆ C → A ⊆ C := by intro hAB hBC x hx; exact hBC (hAB hx)

cards.canonical_statement: For all sets A, B, C, if A ⊆ C and B ⊆ C then A ∪ B ⊆ C.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/><OMV name="C"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="C"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="B"/><OMV name="C"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="union"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA><OMV name="C"/></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Split membership in the union and use the corresponding inclusion hypothesis.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary candidate element of the source set.
unpack: Use the given subset or membership hypotheses.
derive: Apply the relevant inclusion rule to the element.
conclude: Since the element was arbitrary, establish the target subset or equality.
cards.lean_witness:
example {α : Type} (A B C : Set α) : A ⊆ C → B ⊆ C → A ∪ B ⊆ C := by
  intro hAC hBC x hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · exact hAC hx
  · exact hBC hx

cards.canonical_statement: For all sets A, B, C, if C ⊆ A and C ⊆ B then C ⊆ A ∩ B.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/><OMV name="C"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="C"/><OMV name="A"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="C"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMV name="C"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="intersect"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Use both inclusion hypotheses to build intersection membership.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary candidate element of the source set.
unpack: Use the given subset or membership hypotheses.
derive: Apply the relevant inclusion rule to the element.
conclude: Since the element was arbitrary, establish the target subset or equality.
cards.lean_witness: example {α : Type} (A B C : Set α) : C ⊆ A → C ⊆ B → C ⊆ A ∩ B := by intro hCA hCB x hx; exact ⟨hCA hx, hCB hx⟩

cards.canonical_statement: For all sets A and B, A \ B is a subset of A.
cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="subset"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="setdiff"/><OMV name="A"/><OMV name="B"/></OMA><OMV name="A"/></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
cards.proof_strategy: Unpack difference membership and retain its A-membership component.
sketch_steps: setup: Fix an arbitrary candidate element of the source set.
